task_description: Write a method in Dafny to remove all whitespaces from the given string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method RemoveWhitespaces(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The resulting string v contains no whitespace characters
- The length of v is less than or equal to the length of the input string s
- All non-whitespace characters from s are preserved in v in the same order
